from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section7Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Configuration
        TITLE = "Summary: Efficiency through Geometry"
        LINES = [
            "Pure series exploit the inherent symmetry of physical systems.",
            "Symmetry reduces our computational work by half.",
            "Elegant geometry makes complex math much more efficient."
        ]
        
        # Colors based on storyboard/lecture consistency
        COLOR_COMPLEX = WHITE
        COLOR_SIMPLE = WHITE
        COLOR_SAVING = "#00FF00"
        COLOR_STRING = "#ADD8E6"
        COLOR_FINAL = WHITE

        self.setup_layout(TITLE, LINES)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Complex formula vs Simple formula
        # Storyboard: "Left: Complex formula vs Right: Simple formula (#FFFFFF)."
        # Using symmetrical positioning (Belief B040) around midline x=3.0
        complex_tex = MathTex(
            r"f(x) = a_0 + \sum_{n=1}^\infty \left[ a_n \cos\left(\frac{n\pi x}{L}\right) + b_n \sin\left(\frac{n\pi x}{L}\right) \right]",
            color=COLOR_COMPLEX
        )
        simple_tex = MathTex(
            r"f(x) = \sum_{n=1}^\infty b_n \sin\left(\frac{n\pi x}{L}\right)",
            color=COLOR_SIMPLE
        )
        
        # Place symmetrically: Complex in B2-C3 (center x=2.0), Simple in B4-C5 (center x=4.0)
        # Avoid column 1 to respect B021
        self.place_in_area(complex_tex, "B2", "C3", scale_factor=0.35)
        self.place_in_area(simple_tex, "B4", "C5", scale_factor=0.45)
        
        vs_label = Text("vs", color=WHITE, font_size=20)
        # Place vs at the midline x=3.0 (between col 3 and 4)
        self.place_in_area(vs_label, "B3", "B4", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_COMPLEX)
        self.play(
            Write(complex_tex), 
            Write(vs_label), 
            Write(simple_tex), 
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # '50% Less Math' label appears on the right
        # Storyboard: "'50% Less Math' label appears on the right (#00FF00)."
        less_math_label = Text("50% Less Math", color=COLOR_SAVING, font_size=24)
        # Positioned below the simple formula (col 4/5)
        self.place_at_grid(less_math_label, "D4", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        arrow = Arrow(
            start=simple_tex.get_bottom(),
            end=less_math_label.get_top(),
            color=COLOR_SAVING,
            buff=0.1
        )
        
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_SAVING)
        self.play(FadeIn(less_math_label), Create(arrow), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # A vibrating string animation shows physical symmetry
        # Storyboard: "A vibrating string animation shows physical symmetry (#ADD8E6)."
        # Symmetrical area E2 to F5 (x=1.5 to 4.5, center x=3.0)
        start_p = self.grid["E2"]
        end_p = self.grid["E5"]
        L_dist = end_p[0] - start_p[0]
        
        amp_tracker = ValueTracker(0.4)
        
        # Create a VMobject for the string and update points in place (efficient)
        string_mobj = VMobject(color=COLOR_STRING)
        def update_string(mob):
            amp = amp_tracker.get_value()
            points = [
                np.array([
                    start_p[0] + x * L_dist, 
                    start_p[1] + amp * np.sin(PI * x), 
                    0
                ])
                for x in np.linspace(0, 1, 40)
            ]
            mob.set_points_as_corners(points).make_smooth()

        update_string(string_mobj)
        string_mobj.add_updater(update_string)
        
        # Endpoints of the string (respect B001 - no overlap with formulas)
        dot_l = Dot(start_p, color=WHITE, radius=0.06)
        dot_r = Dot(end_p, color=WHITE, radius=0.06)
        
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_STRING)
        self.play(Create(dot_l), Create(dot_r), Create(string_mobj))
        
        # Vibration cycles using ValueTracker
        self.play(amp_tracker.animate.set_value(-0.4), run_time=0.8, rate_func=sine_merge)
        self.play(amp_tracker.animate.set_value(0.4), run_time=0.8, rate_func=sine_merge)
        
        # Closing text: 'Symmetry is efficiency' (#FFFFFF)
        closing_text = Text("Symmetry is efficiency", color=COLOR_FINAL, font_size=28)
        self.place_in_area(closing_text, "F2", "F5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(closing_text))
        
        # Final vibration and settle during conclusion
        self.play(amp_tracker.animate.set_value(-0.4), run_time=0.8, rate_func=sine_merge)
        self.play(amp_tracker.animate.set_value(0.4), run_time=0.8, rate_func=sine_merge)
        self.play(amp_tracker.animate.set_value(0), run_time=1.0, rate_func=smooth)
        
        self.wait(3)
